coordinates.locator: centroid of OpenStreetMap way 723075568 (GSI Helmholtzzentrum für Schwerionenforschung, research institute); GSI is located in Darmstadt (Wixhausen)
coordinates.note: Campus-grade point: the centroid of the OpenStreetMap outline of the GSI research-institute area (about 400 m precision). The SIS18 ring is traced in OSM at about 49.9325, 8.6813 and the UNILAC at about 49.9315, 8.6790, inside this area.

name: GSI Helmholtzzentrum, Darmstadt campus
notes: Placement of last resort for GSI experiments: no fetched source gives a coordinate for the HADES cave.

summary.plain: The campus of the GSI Helmholtz Centre for Heavy Ion Research in Darmstadt, Germany, home of the UNILAC linear accelerator, the SIS18 heavy-ion synchrotron and experiments such as HADES.
summary.technical: GSI Helmholtzzentrum für Schwerionenforschung, Darmstadt: campus-grade point (centroid of the OSM site outline) for the existing GSI accelerators (UNILAC, SIS18, ESR) and the HADES experiment.
